gloss: sleeping comfort; how comfortable something is to sleep on

definitions.gloss: sleeping comfort; quality of sleep comfort
definitions.explanation: The quality of comfort experienced when sleeping on a bed, futon, or other surface.

examples.japanese: この{布団|ふとん}は{寝心地|ねごこち}がいい。
examples.english: This futon is comfortable to sleep on.

examples.japanese: {寝心地|ねごこち}の{良|よ}いマットレスを{買|か}った。
ホテルのベッドは{寝心地|ねごこち}{最高|さいこう}だった。
examples.english: The hotel bed was extremely comfortable.

notes:
FORMS:
{寝|ね}る (to sleep) + {心地|ここち} (feeling, sensation) → feeling while sleeping

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {寝心地|ねごこち}がいい / {良|よ}い (comfortable to sleep on)
- {寝心地|ねごこち}が{悪|わる}い (uncomfortable to sleep on)
- {寝心地|ねごこち}{抜群|ばつぐん} (exceptionally comfortable)

RELATED ～{心地|ごこち} WORDS:
- {居心地|いごこち} (comfort of a place)
- {乗|の}り{心地|ごこち} (ride comfort)
- {着心地|きごこち} (wearing comfort)
- {使|つか}い{心地|ごこち} (ease of use)

USAGE:
Commonly used for describing mattresses, futons, pillows, and beds. Frequently seen in bedding product reviews.
